facts.fact: The MaDiPHS Knowledge Library lists a downloadable hourly temperature dataset (xls, csv) from automatic weather stations run by TAHMO and Malawi's Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services, created 31 July 2024.
The same MaDiPHS record states the dataset's licence as Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike.
